dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Hmm, if I had enough samples, I could...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, would you look at that? Some strange guy's mumbling over here...

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Me? You can find people like me everywhere in Natlan. If anyone's strange here, it's you... If there's nothing else, please don't interrupt my research.

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: My expenses this month exceeded estimates, so I have to make up the shortfall by solving some of the Association's research bounties.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon didn't know you could get paid to do research...

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: That's the sort of organization the Saurian Relics Association is. Mora is how you encourage research into all manner of topics.

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: This time, I'm going to take on the deciphering of Iridescent Inscriptions... It's said that this great work has never been completed, and the Mora to be had is most sizable indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: It's just that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That what?

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: I'll need enough inscription fragments to perform this task.

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Hmm... How about this? If you could bring me Iridescent Inscription fragments, I'll pay you. How's that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: I mean, you look like seasoned adventurers. I'm sure you get such commissions all the time, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, sure, we could help you. But haven't you run your monthly expenses into the ground already...?

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Well, since we're over budget, it doesn't matter how far over we are... But that'll stop being a problem if I get those fragments and decipher them — I guarantee it!

choices.text: We'll only be finding those fragments...

response.speaker: Chuno
response.text: Not to worry. All you have to do is ensure that you find me "genuine" goods. And I do mean that — just thinking of how some huckster sold me some fake items from the "Remnants of the Secret Source"... Why, it makes my blood boil!

response.speaker: Chuno
response.text: That was no small sum of Mora I forfeited in that transaction...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, so that's how you burst your budget...

response.speaker: Chuno
response.text: And precisely why I need to make a comeback using these inscriptions!

response.speaker: Chuno
response.text: So, please! I'm counting on you to find those fragments! Find and bring them to me, would you kindly?

response.speaker: Chuno
response.text: I don't even need that many. Just... three? No, four! I mean, I couldn't afford to pay for more...

choices.text: No guarantees that they'll be useful to you...

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: So, have you found those Iridescent Inscription fragments...?

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Haha! Good, good! I'll crack the code on the Inscriptions' golden patterns soon enough... and then... The reward shall be mine!

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Not that I have a choice — if I fail again, I'll be out of funds, so it's sink or swim for me!

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Ah, right. Here's your payment, by the by.

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! Thanks for bringing me those inscription fragments.

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: Still, the progress I'm making deciphering them is... worrisome. Their similarities to Phlogiston Engravings are merely ostensible — the complexity therein is far greater than I had imagined...

dialogues.speaker: Chuno
dialogues.text: But there's no going back now, so... I've gotta get this done either way, hahaha!
